subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage.
guide_solution: Summary The whole passage deals with the rate of literacy and illiteracy of a certain country. The high standard of living depends much upon the literate people. Poverty as well as backwardness is the main obstacle of removing illiteracy. Illiteracy is the only reason of ignorance which frustrates all development efforts of the government and the community. So it is our social duty and responsibility to remove illiteracy from the country through the concerted efforts.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Rajuk Uttara Model College, Dhaka. Sl.No. 13; Page No. 58
